identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I Trial of CD19 Targeted ICAR19 T Cells in Patients With CD19+ Leukemia and Lymphoma.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Measure the safety of ICAR19 CAR-T cells
primaryOutcomes.description: To assess the adverse events of ICAR19 T cells infusion in patients with CD19+ malignancies

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Measure the anti-tumor effect of ICAR19 CAR-T cells
secondaryOutcomes.description: Assess for the therapeutic effects of ICAR 19 CAR-T cells in CD19-expressing leukemia and lymphoma

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Survival time of ICAR19 T cells in vivo.
secondaryOutcomes.description: To measure the survival time of ICAR19 CAR-T cells in vivo, extra blood will be drawn from patients receive ICAR19 T cells infusion in the follow-up time
